en: The Question on Knowing the Happiness of Nibbāna
"Venerable Nāgasena, does one who has not attained nibbāna know that 'nibbāna is happiness'?
"Yes, Great King, one who has not attained nibbāna knows that 'nibbāna is happiness.'"
“How, venerable Nāgasena, does one who does not possess it know that ‘Nirvana is happiness’?
“What do you think, great king? Would those whose hands and feet have not been cut off know, great king, that ‘the cutting off of hands and feet is suffering’?
“Venerable sir, having heard the sound of lamentation from others whose hands and feet have been cut off, they know: ‘The cutting off of hands and feet is suffering.
“In the same way, great king, having heard the sound from those who have seen Nibbāna, one knows: ‘Nibbāna is bliss.’”
This is the tenth question, concerning the knowledge of the bliss of Nibbāna.
This is the fourth chapter on Nibbāna.
In this chapter, there are ten questions.
